what: what was actually dispatched, on both sides, and by what means
everySequenceIsRealInput: mouse, wheel and touch are dispatched as trusted browser input through the automation protocol. No QA hook moves either page. The one exception is labelled: wheel deltaMode 1 and 2 cannot be produced by a real device through the protocol and are dispatched as synthetic WheelEvents, which still reach a listener if one exists.
